Cool Holdings Inc (NASDAQ:AWSM) Reports Decline in Sellers; Strong Momentum for Longs Posted by Clifton Ray 30 pm
The stock of Cool Holdings Inc (NASDAQ:AWSM) registered a decrease of 0.34% in short interest. AWSM’s total short interest was 147,600 shares in December as published by FINRA. Its down 0.34% from 148,100 shares, reported previously. With 161,300 shares average volume, it will take short sellers 1 days to cover their AWSM’s short positions. The short interest to Cool Holdings Inc’s float is 4.59%.
The stock decreased 1.42% or $0.0232 during the last trading session, reaching $1.6068. About 18,197 shares traded. Cool Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:AWSM) has declined 77.18% since December 12, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 77.18% the S&P500.
Cool Holdings, Inc. manufactures and sells wireless handsets, tablets, and related products to the carriers, distributors, and retailers in Latin America. The company has market cap of $12.52 million. The firm sells its products under the verykool brand. It currently has negative earnings. It operates OneClick store located in the El Solar Shopping district in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
